title: Daily commute suitability
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G60 as fitting daily commuting needs through comfort, range, charging fit, and city-driving usability, though many examples are too brief or descriptive to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise commute comfort and adequate range for daily travel.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe commute fit, home charging, electric-only commuting, efficiency, fuel-cost reduction, and city-driving suitability without clear evaluative sentiment in enough detail.

limitations: Most examples in this topic are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence about overall customer attitude.
Several undetermined fragments are very brief or purely descriptive, so concrete sentiment cannot be inferred beyond the supplied labels.
The topic is fairly coherent around commuting and daily-use suitability, but evidence for some aspects is limited to single examples.
